response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer with strong general engineering skills, but is a poor fit for this embedded networking security role. He lacks the required native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, minimal recent C/UNIX work (only a brief stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015), and no background in networking security technologies such as MACsec, 802.1X, or switch firmware development.
strengths: Solid Linux experience and some low-level/systems exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, D-based low-latency services)
Strong software craftsmanship practices: TDD, CI/CD, testing culture, and open-source contributions
Broad, adaptable engineering background across web, mobile, desktop, and light embedded work
concerns: No native-level Japanese proficiency, a hard requirement for the role
No Linux kernel analysis/modification or embedded firmware development experience
No exposure to L2/L3 networking security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF) or switch products

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking/security or kernel experience
